body: Forward test of the base rate method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.20 (naive base rate 0.30) that: Tata Steel announces a binding (definitive) agreement with the Dutch State/North Holland on the IJmuiden decarbonisation project by 31-Mar-2027. Evidence: Q2 FY27 call (Nov-2026): 'Tata Steel, the Government of the Netherlands and the Province of North Holland have agreed to extend the Joint Letter of Intent by five months to March 2027… additional time… towards a more comprehensive framework'; 'while the DRI–EAF pathway remains the reference case… we continue to assess a range of strategic alternatives and sequencing options'; outcomes 'difficult to predict'. JLoI signed Sep-2025. Netherlands EBITDA €72 mn in Q2 (€56/t) after DSP restart; European gas >2× Jan-2026 levels. Consolidated net debt ₹91,423 cr. Reasoning: A first extension plus explicit talk of 'strategic alternatives' are classic signs that a subsidy deal is not converging; Tata Steel also faces UK losses and high net debt, lowering its appetite to commit. Below base. Resolution: YES if, on or before 31-Mar-2027, Tata Steel (stock-exchange filing or press release) announces a signed binding/definitive agreement (e.g., 'agreement', 'binding term sheet', 'final investment framework') with the Dutch State and/or Province of North Holland for the IJmuiden decarbonisation/health project. A further extension of the LoI, an MoU or a non-binding framework = NO. Source: Tata Steel NSE/BSE announcements; Tata Steel / Rijksoverheid press releases. Resolve by 2027-04-15; score with Brier vs base rate.

body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #1, company drawn at random (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.08 (naive base rate 0.15) that: Sunflag sells or transfers any of its 6.00 crore Lloyds Metals & Energy shares on or before 30-Sep-2027. Our reasoning: no stated monetisation intent in 4 annual reports; 74 lakh shares pledged to Indian Bank as collateral; dividend Re 1 (~9% payout); the stake funds nothing yet, but the mining programme could create a reason in 2027-28. Naive base: rough annual rate of a stake sale/transfer event at Indian holdcos/opcos with a large listed stake [EST, unverified; insight:group-holdco-discount says catalysts are rare]. Resolution: YES if any filing up to 30-Sep-2027 (Sunflag Reg-30 or results notes, SAST Reg 29(2) disclosures, LMEL shareholding patterns up to the quarter ended 30-Jun-2027, or the Sep-2027 LMEL SHP if filed by the check date) shows Sunflag holding fewer than 6,00,00,000 LMEL shares, or a sale/transfer agreement. Pledge or invocation counts as YES only if shares are actually transferred. Source: NSE announcements (SUNFLAG, LLOYDSME) + LMEL shareholding pattern XBRL + Sunflag FY27 AR note 4. Resolve by 2027-09-30; score with Brier vs the base rate to test whether deep-dive probabilities beat naive base rates.
